result = None

import rospy
import math
from robot_sdk.navigation_sdk import Nav2Anywhere

print("Step 1: 播报开始任务")
tts.initialize()
tts.speak("开始任务")
print("播报完成")

print("\nStep 2: 查询茶水间坐标")
result = memory.query_place("茶水间")
place = result[0]
pose_data = place["target_pose"]

x = pose_data["x"]
y = pose_data["y"]
z = pose_data["z"]
qx = pose_data["qx"]
qy = pose_data["qy"]
qz = pose_data["qz"]
qw = pose_data["qw"]
norm = math.sqrt(qx * qx + qy * qy + qz * qz + qw * qw)
qx /= norm
qy /= norm
qz /= norm
qw /= norm

print("目标: (%.3f, %.3f) 四元数 q=(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f, %.4f)" % (x, y, qx, qy, qz, qw))

nav = Nav2Anywhere()
nav.publish_simple_goal(x=x, y=y, z=z, qx=qx, qy=qy, qz=qz, qw=qw)

print("等待到达位置...")
reached = nav.wait_until_reached(timeout_sec=120.0, yaw_threshold=math.pi)
print("位置到达: " + str(reached))

if reached:
    print("\nStep 3: 播报...")
    tts.speak("来瓶咖啡")
    print("播报完成")
else:
    print("导航超时或失败")
